groups.name: write_throughput
groups.note: Bulk insert of N fresh keys into an empty engine, then one flush. Covers open, memtable inserts and the flush that writes the table. Both engines compress blocks on 4 threads.

groups.name: overwrite
groups.note: Every key written a second time into an engine that already holds one copy, then one flush. Memtable churn over existing keys and a superseding flush. Both engines compress blocks on 4 threads. ours-deferred-wal: our engine with a caller-kept log, the log written and synced once and the flush deferred, one sync per batch as in SurrealKV's commit.

groups.name: overwrite_sustained
groups.note: 100,000 keys, then 15 rewrites of a hot set of 20,000 of them, with compaction behind the writes and a reader alongside. 4 MiB memtables, 2 MiB tables, 4 L0 runs per compaction, no write-ahead log on either. Ours flushes on a thread of its own as RocksDB does, one sealed memtable at a time as RocksDB's two write buffers allow, with deferred durability and one sync barrier per 8 flushes; it runs leveled compaction on another thread and stops writes at 36 L0 runs, RocksDB's stop trigger. Time per write; beside it the compaction bytes per written byte until compaction rests, the disk bytes over live bytes when the last write lands, and the reader's p50 and p99.

groups.name: point_read
groups.note: One get per stored key on a warm engine. Also our hash index, ribbon locator and row cache, and RocksDB's hash index, on the same chart.

groups.name: multi_get
groups.note: One batched lookup of the whole key set on a warm engine (RocksDB: batched_multi_get_cf).

groups.name: range_scan
groups.note: A full forward scan reading every value on a warm engine.

groups.name: seek_random
groups.note: A seek to each key in scattered order, reading the value under the cursor.

groups.name: major_compact_zstd3
groups.note: Six overlapping L0 tables merged into one level, 4-thread block compression, no range split. zstd level 3, the level RocksDB applies to bottommost output.

groups.name: subcompaction_zstd3
groups.note: A full overwrite in six L0 tables merged into a bottom level of several tables, split into 4 parallel ranges. High-entropy values. zstd level 3.
